title: Love for create!
description: NeoForge 1.21.1 Create-focused tech modpack — no quests, just relaxed long-term “forever world” building and automation.
body:
# General info

**Love for Create!** is a Minecraft 1.21.1 (NeoForge) tech-style modpack built mainly around the Create mod and many Create add-ons. There are no quests and no forced progression changes — the goal is simple: chill, build, automate, and keep the same world for a long time.

If you want a pack that supports a long-running “forever world” where you gradually expand factories and infrastructure, this pack is designed for that vibe.

# What’s in the pack

Create-centered tech gameplay (Create + many Create expansions)

No quests — relaxed sandbox play

Client + server sided (made for singleplayer or multiplayer servers)

Vanilla-style base gameplay with additional tech items from included mods

# World generation

World generation is normal Minecraft, with Create’s own generation (e.g., its ores like copper/zinc depending on your Create setup/addons).
I am not claiming any extra worldgen mods beyond Create.

Performance / requirements

This pack is intended for mid-range PCs and you stated 6GB RAM can handle it easily.


### Menu video credit

YouTube video: ["This is create! (2022)"](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rR8W-f9YhYA)
